text: Samruk-Kazyna is Kazakhstan's sovereign wealth fund, founded in 2008 by decree of the President of Kazakhstan; its audited IFRS financial statements state that the Government of the Republic of Kazakhstan is the Fund's sole shareholder and ultimate controlling party.
short: The Government of Kazakhstan is Samruk-Kazyna's sole shareholder.

source.name: Sovereign Wealth Fund Samruk-Kazyna JSC — 1H 2025 Consolidated Financial Statements (IFRS)
source.quote: The Government is the sole shareholder (hereinafter − the “Shareholder” or the “Parent”)  and the ultimate controlling party of the Fund in accordance with IFRS accounting standards.
source.note: Quote contains a double space after the closing parenthesis, as in the PDF text layer.

additionalSources.name: Economics Atlas — Samruk-Kazyna (institution profile)
additionalSources.quote: Wholly owned by the Government of Kazakhstan, it holds controlling or partial stakes in the country's major national companies, including KazMunayGas, Kazakhtelecom, KEGOC, Kazpost, Air Astana and Kazatomprom
